constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require Ruby language and gem changes; confirm handlers run on the replacement before deploying.

steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from ruby3.2 to a supported AWS Lambda Ruby identifier (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime

steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins ruby3.2.
steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

rules.summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists ruby3.2 under Deprecated runtimes with deprecation date 2026-03-31. AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.
rules.title: AWS Lambda Ruby 3.2 runtime is end-of-life
